name: Avant Corporation
summary: Avant Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides business intelligence, data integration, and system engineering services. The company also offers consolidated accounting and business management services; and business outsourcing services. In addition, it provides disclosure information search and financial analysis services; search engine for laws, accounting, and tax practice; and English disclosure document creation services. AVANT Corporation has strategic alliance with Metapraxis Ltd. The company was formerly known as Diva Corporation and changed its name to Avant Corporation in October 2013. Avant Corporation was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
